name: @xenosite/xpict
description: Declarative molecule depiction for publication-quality vector graphics — Rust, Python, or the web (JS/WASM)
author: S. Joshua Swamidass <swamidass@gmail.com>

scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts && npm run build:copy-wasm
scripts.check:pocs: tsc --strict --module ES2022 --moduleResolution bundler --target ES2022 --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --types node --noEmit pocs/elk_layout.ts
scripts.test:api: tsx src/api.smoke.ts && tsx src/cxsmiles.smoke.ts && tsx src/align.smoke.ts
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run check:pocs && npm run test:api
scripts.prepack: npm run build:ts && npm run build:copy-wasm
